## Tag companies (Haiku 5.5)
Takes up to 100 untagged companies (view companies_to_tag), reads each one's job board, and asks Claude for name, description, sector, type, size and UK locations, using only the options in taxonomy_options. Anything off-list or low-confidence is flagged needs_review.
